title: Generation of human hair-bearing skin organoids from stem cells
protocol: Perform every step in the biosafety cabinet.
Prior to starting the experiment, prepare 10 ml of E8-10Y and 22 ml of E8-20Y media.
Aspirate spent medium from cells in one well of a 6-well culture plate at 75% confluency.
Wash with 2.5 ml of 1X DPBS for twice, aspirating the DPBS after each wash.
Add 500 µl of Accutase and incubate for 3-4 minutes in a 37°C incubator with 5.0% CO₂.
Add 1 ml of E8-10Y medium to gently pipette up-and-down, breaking up cell clusters into single cells within the well.
Collect all cell suspension into a 15 ml tube and add additional 4 ml of E8-10Y, making a final volume of 5.5 ml.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes 30 seconds at 230 rcf to pellet cells.
Carefully and completely remove supernatant by aspiration without disturbing the cell pellet.
Resuspend cells in 1 ml of E8-10Y medium by gently pipetting up-and-down.
Equilibrate cell strainer by forcefully adding 1 ml of E8-10Y medium through the strainer mesh.
Add resuspended cells prepared in step #8 onto the cell strainer in a drop-wise manner.
Add another 1 ml of E8-10Y medium onto the cell strainer in a drop-wise manner.
Carefully remove and discard the cell strainer snap cap.
Count the number of live cells in the cell suspension using Trypan blue at 1:1 dilution.
Calculate the volume of cell suspension needed for cell culture.
Remove the same volume as the cell suspension that is needed for culture from 22 ml of E8-20Y medium prepared earlier.
Add the adequate volume of your cell suspension to the E8-20Y medium.
Remove 1.54 ml from the 22 ml E8-20Y medium.
Add 1.54 ml of cell suspension in E8-10Y into the 20.46 ml of E8-20Y medium.
Invert several times or swirl the tube to mix the cell suspension evenly.
Pour the 22 ml cell suspension into a 25 ml reservoir.
Using a multi-channel pipette, aliquot 100 µl of cell suspension into each well of 96-well U-bottom plates (this makes 3500 cells per well).
Spin down the plates at 110 rcf for 6 min at room temperature.
Incubate the plates in 37°C incubator with 5.0% CO2 for 24 hrs.
Prepare 22 ml of fresh E8 medium containing 44 µl of Normocin (100 µg/ml, WITHOUT Y).
Pour 22 ml of fresh E8 medium into a 25 ml reservoir.
Using a multi-channel pipette, add 100 µl of E8 medium into each well, which brings total volume to 200 µl per well.
Incubate the plates in 37°C incubator with 5.0% CO2.
Thaw 600 µl of Matrigel on ice overnight at 4°C.
Prepare 30 ml of E6-based differentiation medium containing 2% Matrigel, 10 µM SB, 4 ng/ml FGF, and 2.5 ng/ml BMP4.
Collect all aggregates from 96-well U-bottom plates to a 2 ml round-bottom tube using wide-orifice p200 tips with a multi-channel pipette.
Concentrate all aggregates into the center of a 100 mm petri-dish by gently swirling.
Transfer all concentrated aggregates into a 2 ml round-bottom tube using a wide-orifice p1000 tip.
Carefully remove excessive E8 medium from the tube containing aggregates.
Wash the aggregates with 1 ml of E6 medium three times to completely remove traces of E8 medium.
Add 1 ml of E6SFB medium to the tube containing aggregates.
Place a new 100 mm petri-dish on ice and add approximately 15 ml of E6SFB medium.
Transfer all aggregates to the petri-dish containing the medium on ice using a wide-orifice p1000 tip.
Transfer individual aggregate in a volume of 100 μl of E6SFB medium into each well in a new 96-well U-bottom plate using a wide-orifice p200 tip.
Incubate in a 37°C incubator with 5.0% CO₂.
Observe morphological changes every day.
Prepare 5 ml of E6 medium containing 1 µM LDN and 250 ng/ml FGF.
Pour 5 ml of prepared E6LF medium into a 10 ml reservoir.
Using a multi-channel pipette, add 25 μl of the E6LF medium per well into the aggregate culture in 96-well U-bottom plates (exclude wells on each edge).
Gently tap the plates to mix the medium.
Incubate in a 37°C incubator with 5.0% CO₂.
Prepare 11 ml of fresh E6 medium containing 22 µl Normocin.
Pour the prepared E6 medium into a 10 ml reservoir.
Using a multi-channel pipette, add 75 µl per well into each well in 96-well U-bottom plates, making a final volume of 200 µl per well.
Gently tap the plates to mix the medium.
Incubate in 37°C incubator with 5.0% CO₂.
Prepare 14 ml of fresh E6 medium containing 28 µl Normocin.

Using wide-orifice p200 tips and a multi-channel pipette, at about 60˚ angle, very carefully remove 100 µl of spent medium from each well of 96-well U-bottom plate, remaining 100 µl of medium in each well.
Pour the E6 medium into a 25 ml reservoir.
Using a multi-channel pipette, add 100 µl of fresh E6 medium into each well, making a final volume of 200 µl per well.
Gently tap the plates to mix the medium.
Incubate in 37°C incubator with 5.0% CO₂.
Thaw 630 μl of Matrigel on ice overnight at 4°C.
Prepare 63 ml of OMM containing 1% Matrigel.
Collect all aggregates in a 2 ml round bottom tube using a p1000 tip with a wide mouth.
Carefully remove excessive medium from the tube.
Wash aggregates three times with 1 ml of Advanced DMEM/F12 medium.
Remove all washing medium after each wash.
Place the tube containing aggregates on ice.
Add 1 ml of OMM1%M into the tube containing aggregates.
Pour OMM1%M into a cooled petri-dish placed on ice.
Transfer all aggregates into the OMM1%M in the petri-dish using a wide mouth p1000 tip.
Transfer each aggregate in 500 μl of OM1%M into each well in 24-well low-attachment plates.
Gently swirl to ensure each well is completely covered by medium and aggregates are not floating on the surface.
Incubate in a 37°C incubator with 5.0% CO₂ on a shaker at 65 rpm for consistent, gentle agitation.
Thaw 320 µl of Matrigel on ice overnight at 4°C.
Prepare 32 ml of OMM containing 1% Matrigel (OMM1%M).
Remove 250 µl of spent medium from each well of the 24-well plates, leaving 250 µl per well.
Add 250 µl of freshly prepared OMM1%M into each well, making a final volume of 500 µl per well.
Gently swirl the plates to evenly mix the medium.
Incubate in a 37°C incubator with 5.0% CO₂ on a shaker at 65 rpm.
Prepare 32 ml fresh OMM without Matrigel.
Remove 250 µl of spent medium from each well of the 24-well low-attachment plates, leaving 250 µl per well.
Add 250 μl of freshly prepared OM into each well.
Gently swirl the plates to evenly mix the medium.
Incubate in a 37°C incubator with 5.0% CO₂ on a shaker at 65 rpm.
Perform half-medium changes every three days using OMM from differentiation day 18 to 45.
Afterwards, perform half-medium changes every other day and include full medium change once every week by completely removing medium (500 μl) from each well and adding 500 μl of fresh OMM.
Increase total volume of medium per well to 1 ml as organoids mature and grow older, starting from day-80.
